林 JASON LINFOR FUHSD · AREA 3

DONATE VOLUNTEER Menu
EN / 简中
My Plan My Story Why Now Endorsements Watch Jason DONATE VOLUNTEER
FREMONT UNION HIGH SCHOOL DISTRICT (FUHSD) · TRUSTEE AREA 3
# StudentsWin with Lin.
Future FUHSD parent 5 unicorn companies Guest lecturer,
UC Berkeley Haas School of Business
This is why I care.
My two children will soon enter FUHSD schools. I care deeply about what happens next—for them and every student whose future is being shaped today.
Public schools gave me the American Dream. Now I’m running to protect that promise for every student.
Check my trustee area ↗ My Story →
Election Day: November 3, 2026Voting begins October 5
Watch Video
THE PROMISE
Protect schools.
Prepare students.
Partner with parents.
WHY ME
## I’m a builder. I turn ambitious plans into results.
5
### Unicorn companies
I’ve built and scaled organizations through complexity and change.
UC Berkeley
### Guest lecturer, Haas School of Business
I teach future leaders to connect strategy, execution, and results.
2
### Future FUHSD students
I’m a father with a direct, personal stake in the district’s next chapter.
20+
### Years building
I turn ambitious goals into measurable results.
## Are You in Trustee Area 3?
Election Day · November 3, 2026
FUHSD serves Cupertino, Sunnyvale, and Los Altos. I’m running to represent Trustee Area 3. Trustee areas determine who elects each Board member; they do not change school attendance boundaries.
Monta Vista HS · Homestead HS · Cupertino HS · Fremont HS · Lynbrook HS
Check whether you’re in Area 3 ↗
FUHSD Trustee Area 3 highlighted (Official FUHSD Map ↗)
MY THREE-PART PLAN
## Protect. Prepare.
Partner.
Protect the schools and teachers families count on.
Prepare every student for college, careers, and life.
Partner with parents—and earn their trust.
01 · Protect
### Protect schools and teachers
Great schools require great teachers—and campuses families can count on.
- I will oppose closing Monta Vista High School or Homestead High School. I will also require a full public process before any campus decision.
- Preserve rigorous courses and retain excellent teachers
- Cut duplicative reporting and red tape so teachers can focus on teaching
02 · Prepare
### Prepare every student
Every student needs a path forward—and support to walk it.
- Teach practical, responsible AI literacy in every school
- Expand internships with local employers and build clear college, career, and entrepreneurship pathways
- Find students falling behind early—including English Learners—and fund what measurably closes the gaps
03 · Partner
### Partner with parents
Parents belong in decisions—not in the audience after they are made.
- Respect parents as the primary decision-makers in their children’s education; schools should support—not replace—that relationship
- Give families a real voice while choices are still open
- Publish goals, results, tradeoffs, and student impact before major votes
MY FISCAL STANDARD
### Before Board members get a raise, students should see results.
I will not support higher Board compensation without public debate, fiscal justification, and measurable progress for students.
Me, shortly after arriving in the United States
MY STORY
## Public schools gave me the American Dream.
I came to America as a young child unable to speak English. In a public-school classroom, teachers saw possibility in me before I could see it in myself. They gave me the language, confidence, and opportunity to find my way.
At UCLA, I graduated as a commencement speaker. From there, I earned a top-tier MBA from the University of Michigan Ross School of Business and built a career helping grow five unicorn companies. Today, I pass those lessons forward as a guest lecturer at the UC Berkeley Haas School of Business.
Public schools changed the course of my life. Now, as the father of two future FUHSD students, protecting that promise could not be more personal. I’m running to ensure every child—wherever their story begins—has the opportunity and preparation to write their own.
With your vote, I will bring to the Board an executive’s discipline, an educator’s curiosity, an immigrant’s gratitude, and a father’s sense of urgency.
Guest lecturing at the UC Berkeley Haas School of Business
WHY I’M RUNNING
## This is personal.
My wife and I are raising two future FUHSD students. I want what every parent wants: schools that remain excellent, respond when students struggle, and prepare our children for the world they will inherit.
CAMPAIGN IN ACTION
## Watch Jason Lin on the Issues
From the official candidate forum to in-depth media conversations, hear Jason speak directly to voters about protecting academic excellence, supporting student wellness, and holding our district accountable.
Candidate Debate · League of Women Voters
### FUHSD Candidate Forum: Lin vs. Kim

Watch Jason Lin outline his clear roadmap on academic rigor, student mental health, campus closures, and budget stewardship in the official LWV debate.
Jump to Specific Topics (14 Chapters) → YouTube ↗
Media Interview · UChannelTV
### From 5 Unicorns to School Board: Why I’m Running
高中把学生归属感当教育目标？五家独角兽操盘手听完沉默了，转身决定去选学区委员
An in-depth feature exploring Jason's background, educational philosophy, and commitment to student achievement.
Watch Highlights & Video Clips → YouTube ↗
Explore All Videos, Debates & Transcripts →
COMMUNITY VOICES
## Trusted Across Our Community
Elected leaders, education trustees, commissioners, and local parents who know Jason and believe in his vision for FUHSD schools.
Community Leader
### Sashikala Begur
30-Year Monta Vista Cupertino Resident
De Anza Lions Board Member
“Jason is the candidate with a direct stake in our community.”
I’m endorsing Jason Lin for FUHSD trustee: a future Monta Vista parent, public-school graduate & Monta Vista resident committed to protecting our public schools & school property from private-school or developer sales. His opponent doesn’t even live here, so Jason is the candidate with a direct stake in our community.
★ Elected Official
### Liang Chao
Former Vice Mayor, City of Cupertino
Former CUSD School Board Trustee
“Jason understands firsthand what employers need in an AI-powered world.”
Jason Lin builds and scales companies and understands firsthand what employers need in an AI-powered world. He knows AI makes human skills like communication and critical thinking more valuable. He'll keep academic excellence the foundation while expanding internships and career pathways. He'll help every student reach their potential: more challenge for high achievers, more support for those who struggle. I'm proud to support Jason for the FUHSD Board.
Parents & Families
### Tony Guan
Parent of 2 Homestead Students
FUHSD Community Parent
“Jason will ensure our school district puts our kids first.”
Jason will bring his rich entrepreneur experience into our FUHSD and hold our educators accountable. He has 2 incoming Monta Vista High students, and he will ensure our school district put our kids first. The school district succeeds when our students succeed. The school district should serve the students, not any special interest group.
I believe in Jason Lin, and I endorse him for FUHSD Trustee!
★ Elected Official
### Long Jiao
Board Trustee, Cupertino Union SD
Elected Public Education Trustee
“A leader of real integrity, humility, and genuine care for students.”
I’m proud to endorse Jason Lin for the Fremont Union High School District Board. I know Jason personally, and he’s exactly the kind of leader our high schools need—a person of real integrity, humility, and genuine care for students and families. He listens, he shows up, and he’ll put their needs first. Please join me in supporting Jason.

# Trusted Across Our Community
Elected leaders, education trustees, commissioners, parents, and community members supporting Jason Lin for Fremont Union High School District Board of Trustees (Area 3).
Area 3 Neighborhood Gathering
GRASSROOTS COALITION
## A True Grassroots Coalition Across Area 3
“From Cupertino living rooms to Sunnyvale and Los Altos neighborhoods, families are united for Jason Lin.”
Protect the schools and teachers families count on.
Prepare every student for college, careers, and life.
Partner with parents—and earn their trust.
Cupertino · Sunnyvale · Los Altos
100% Parent & Community Powered
## Elected Leaders Who Know Our Schools
★ Elected Official
### R “Ray” Wang
Cupertino City Councilman
“Parents need to put students first.”
Parents need to put students first. We need school board members who advocate for excellence, meritocracy, and parental control. Cupertino's schools have been successful because of active parents who demand the best. Jason Lin exemplifies a parent focused, student centric approach that will ensure the schools stay normal and not succumb to the crazy.
★ Elected Official
### Liang Chao
Former Vice Mayor, City of Cupertino
Former CUSD School Board Trustee
“Jason understands firsthand what employers need in an AI-powered world.”
Jason Lin builds and scales companies and understands firsthand what employers need in an AI-powered world. He knows AI makes human skills like communication and critical thinking more valuable. He'll keep academic excellence the foundation while expanding internships and career pathways. He'll help every student reach their potential: more challenge for high achievers, more support for those who struggle. I'm proud to support Jason for the FUHSD Board.
★ Elected Official
### Long Jiao
Governing Board Trustee, Cupertino Union School District (CUSD)
Elected Public Education Trustee & Community Leader
“A leader of real integrity, humility, and genuine care for our students.”
I’m proud to endorse Jason Lin for the Fremont Union High School District Board. I know Jason personally, and he’s exactly the kind of leader our high schools need- a person of real integrity, humility, and genuine care for students and families. He listens, he shows up, and he’ll put their needs first. Please join me in supporting Jason.
★ Elected Official
### Marc Cooper
Governing School Board Trustee, Franklin McKinley SD
23-Yr Public High School Teacher & U.S. Air Force Veteran
“Jason Lin is the real deal! We need more people like Jason on our school boards.”
Jason Lin is the real deal! We need more people like Jason on our school boards, people who are passionate parents and who professionals in the FUHSD community! Jason has children in the district, and he knows exactly what his children, and other students in the FUHSD need to be best equipped for their post secondary lives. As an active 23 year experienced public high school teacher, as an active School Board Trustee for the TK-8th grade Franklin McKinley School District, as a Veteran of our United States Air Force, and as a proud father of two beautiful daughters, I wholeheartedly endorse Jason Lin for FUHSD School Board in 2026!
★ Elected Official
### Cindy Rocha
School Board Trustee, San Leandro Unified School District
Elected Public Education Trustee & Governance Leader
“Clear, students-first set of priorities that are exactly what we need.”
I am pleased to endorse Jason Lin for the Fremont Union High School District board. As a successful entrepreneur and businessman who has children in the district, he brings both practical experience and a personal stake in the quality of our schools. In our discussions, he has consistently demonstrated a clear, students-first set of priorities that I believe are exactly what the District needs. I support his candidacy and encourage others to do the same.
★ Elected Official
### John Craig
Candidate for Palo Alto School Board
Public Education Advocate & Civic Leader
“Jason Lin's platform is thoughtful, student and family centric.”
Jason Lin's platform is thoughtful, student and family centric and reflects a comprehensive educational approach for students of all interest and capability levels. Also importantly he has demonstrated an ability to lead and get things done for those who choose to invest in him. I encourage the people of FUHSD to do so!
GA
★ Elected Official
### Gwan Alisantosa
Former School Board President, Milpitas Unified SD
Public Education Leader & Governance Veteran
“Jason Lin has the right know-how, experience, and drive to provide leadership.”
Our children are the future of our country. Jason Lin has the right know how, experience, and the drive to provide the leadership needed at FUHSD to ensure all student will be successful.
★ Elected Official
### Tracy Kosolcharoen
Chair, Cupertino Planning Commission
Silicon Valley Tech Executive & Community Leader
“Jason is the rare leader that has strategic vision and positive energy.”
Jason is the rare leader that has strategic vision, a proven ability to deliver on that vision, and positive energy. While his career is filled with executive success, he remains approachable and down-to-earth. I have known Jason and his wonderful family for years, and am certain that our students and families will not only connect with Jason, but be inspired by him. My support is wholeheartedly behind Jason Lin for FUHSD Board Trustee.
★ Elected Official
### Linda Ali Chavez
Board President, Alum Rock Union School District
Elected Public Education Trustee & Board President
“Jason is an exceptional Candidate and the school district would be fortunate to have such an individual on the Board.”
Jason is an exceptional Candidate and the school district would be fortunate to have such an individual on the Board. Serving as an elected school board trustee and board president, I know firsthand the dedication, collaborative spirit, and fiscal responsibility required to guide a district toward excellence.
Jason brings the exact combination of practical leadership, thoughtful vision, and community dedication that our schools need today. As a parent whose children will attend FUHSD schools, he possesses a direct personal commitment to student well-being, educator support, and preparing our young learners for 21st-century success. I am proud to endorse Jason Lin for FUHSD Board of Trustees in Area 3!
★ Education Trustee
### Anthony Tsai
President & Chief Commercial Officer
Former Chair, Board of Trustees, Int'l School of Beijing (2008–2012)
“A vision-oriented leader who will build consensus and collaboration among fellow Trustees.”
Jason has two children in Public School (middle school) so he has a very keen interest in improving the full experience of academics, student development and preparation for a successful future for students. He has real-world experience as a CEO in the e-Commerce/AI sector which gives him insights on the curriculum that is required for success in the new world of AI. He is a vision-oriented leader who will be a tremendous leader to build consensus and collaboration among fellow Trustees. Finally, Jason rolls up his sleeves and works!
WIN WITH LIN!
★ City Commissioner
### Minna Xu
Chair, Cupertino Library Commission
Cupertino Civic Leader & Community Advocate
“A strong community leader who works hard to listen, bring people together, and find win-win solutions.”
Jason Lin is a strong community leader who works hard to engage with the community, listen to people, and develop his own analysis and independent perspective. He looks for ways to bring people together and find win-win solutions that can benefit the broader community. At the same time, he is not afraid to maintain his independent thinking and stand by his principles. I believe he would bring thoughtful, independent leadership to the school board rather than simply serving as a rubber stamp.
★ Elected Official
### Jeff Tang
Board Trustee, Orchard School District
8th-Year School District Board Trustee
“Schools exist to inspire and elevate every student.”
Schools exist to inspire and elevate every student. As an 8th year School District Board Trustee, I proudly endorse Jason Lin for the Fremont Union High School District Board of Trustees.
As a father of two school-aged children, Jason brings a deeply personal, student-centered commitment to our public schools. He understands that academic excellence requires meeting students where they are. Jason will fight to ensure robust support systems for students working to reach grade-level standards, while simultaneously expanding rigorous pathways for high achievers to reach their fullest potential.
Jason's focus on opportunity, high standards, and individual student growth is exactly what the district needs.
MB
★ Elected Official
### Mingi Bodine
In-Coming Lakeside Joint School District Board Member
Educator & Public School Advocate
“Jason is teaching the parents what he preaches.”
The best way for parents to assure the quality of the children's education in public schools is to be involved in school board decision making. Jason is teaching the parents what he preaches.
★ City Council Candidate
### Manisha Pathak
Candidate, Fremont City Council District 4
Civic Leader & Public Education Advocate
“Jason is the leader FUHSD families need. He listens before he acts, and he brings people together around what matters most: students.”
Jason is the leader FUHSD families need. He listens before he acts, and he brings people together around what matters most: students. He has a real commitment to keeping our schools strong, opening opportunity for every student, and making sure parents have a real voice. Jason has a personal stake in these schools and the experience to lead. I’m proud to support Jason Lin for the FUHSD Board.

I’m endorsing Jason Lin for FUHSD trustee: a future Monta Vista parent, public-school graduate & Monta Vista resident committed to protecting our public schools & school property from private-school or developer sales. His opponent doesn’t even live here, so Jason is the candidate with a direct stake in our community.
Parents & Families
### Jeff Lin
Parent of Incoming FUHSD Student
FUHSD Community Parent
“Jason is highly intelligent, competent, and genuinely trustworthy.”
As a parent of a teen entering a FUHSD school next year, choosing our next board trustee is deeply important to me. Having known Jason and his family for years, I've seen firsthand his devotion as a parent and his upstanding integrity. Jason is highly intelligent, competent, and genuinely trustworthy. Because his own two kids will be attending a FUHSD school, he has a direct, personal stake in our district's success. I have absolute confidence that Jason will bring his considerable talents to the board to ensure an effective, positive, and thriving learning environment for all our youth. Please join me in supporting Jason for FUHSD Board Trustee!
VC
Parents & Alumni
### Victor Chang
Area 3 Cupertino Parent
Monta Vista High School Alumnus
“Jason has the integrity to do what is right and the skillset to be effective.”
As someone who graduated from Monta Vista 25 years ago, one of the key considerations for moving back to the area was the high school. I believe Jason has the integrity to do what is right and the skillset to be effective in representing Area 3 on the school board.
Parents & Families
### Tony Guan
Parent of 2 Homestead Students
FUHSD Community Parent
“Jason will ensure our school district puts our kids first.”
Jason will bring his rich entrepreneur experience into our FUHSD and hold our educators accountable. He has 2 incoming Monta Vista High students, and he will ensure our school district put our kids first. The school district succeeds when our students succeed. The school district should serve the students, not any special interest group.
I believe in Jason Lin, and I endorse him for FUHSD Trustee!
HL
Parents & Families
### Hui Liu
Monta Vista Parent
FUHSD Area 3 Neighborhood Parent
“Jason lives within 500 meters from Monta Vista High. He will never support closing the school.”
Jason is a future FUHSD parent and he lives within 500 meters from Monta Vista High School. He understands our neighborhood families, our shared pride in our schools, and will never support closing or diminishing our local campuses.
Having a trustee who lives right here in the Monta Vista neighborhood gives parents the reassurance that our voices and concerns will be heard on the board. Jason brings dynamic leadership, real-world business experience, and an unwavering commitment to protect school attendance boundaries, sustain strong enrollment, and keep our academic standards at the highest level. I strongly endorse Jason Lin for FUHSD Trustee!
Community Leaders
### Ronit Goldstein
Business and Community Leader
Marketing Executive
“Jason Lin is the kind of leader who brings out the best in the people around him.”
Jason Lin is the kind of leader who brings out the best in the people around him. I’ve seen firsthand his ability to think critically, bring people together, and build strong, collaborative teams. He leads with thoughtfulness, integrity, and a genuine commitment to helping others succeed.
KE
Community Members
### Ken Eng
Monta Vista Resident
Neighborhood Resident of 5+ Years
“He has integrity, strong values and a great commitment to our schools and community.”
I am endorsing Jason Lin for FUHSD school board. I have known Jason for over 5 years, since he moved into our neighborhood. He has integrity, strong values and a great commitment to our schools and community. Jason is thoughtful, listens and collaborates with others on key issues for our community, and has a heart for our students. For these reasons, I endorse Jason Lin for FUHSD school board (Area 3).
HP
Alumni & Business
### Holly Paul
Bay Area Business Owner
Lynbrook High School Alumna
“I’ve seen firsthand the perspective, integrity, and care he brings to the people he works with.”
As an FUHSD alumni and an entrepreneur, I know how important strong leadership, thoughtful decision making, and a commitment to the next generation are. I’ve had the opportunity to know Jason as a mentor and advisor and have seen firsthand the perspective, integrity, and care he brings to the people he works with. I am very proud to support his candidacy for School Board!
Education Advocates
### Luis Buhler
Served as interim CFO for StudentsFirst
Civic & Education Policy Leader
“Jason is the breath of fresh air our school system needs.”
Jason is the breath of fresh air our school system needs. Having served in education leadership and finance as interim CFO for StudentsFirst, I know firsthand that student achievement and fiscal responsibility must go hand in hand. Jason brings a pragmatic, solutions-oriented business background, exceptional analytical acumen, and genuine accountability to the table. He understands how to steward public resources wisely while ensuring every dollar directly enriches classroom instruction, student well-being, and educator support. I am confident Jason Lin will provide the transparent, forward-looking governance that our FUHSD students and families deserve.
Community Members
### Mark St John
Former FUHSD Mathematics Teacher
Former Intel Senior Finance Manager
“Jason Lin understands the challenges many current FUHSD students face.”
As someone who started out as a non-English speaking immigrant student and went on to excel in public schools, Jason Lin understands the challenges many current FUHSD students face. Moreover, he has blazed a trail in the digital economy and is a shining example of the business success our students aspire to. Jason’s eagerness to give back to our students and schools, and to bring authentic learning and development experiences to our young learners would make him an invaluable asset to the FUHSD board.
YL
Community Members
### Yi-Chien Lin
Local Resident
FUHSD Community Member
“Jason listens carefully, genuinely cares about people, and knows how to move forward toward a shared goal.”
Jason listens carefully, genuinely cares about people, and knows how to help a group move forward toward a shared goal. As a friend who has spent time with Jason and his family, I have seen how thoughtfully he approaches parenting and how deeply he cares for his family. I believe that same dedication will serve our students and community well. I especially appreciate his commitment to keeping our schools excellent and preparing every student for the future. I’m happy to support Jason for the FUHSD Board.
JW
Alumni & Community
### Joshua Wong
Local Resident & Lynbrook High School Alumnus
FUHSD Alumnus & Community Supporter
“Jason is thoughtful, principled, and guided by a strong sense of responsibility.”
As an FUHSD alumnus, I’ve seen firsthand how much the high school years can shape a student’s values and opportunities. Jason Lin also has a personal stake in the future of FUHSD, as he has two children who will attend Monta Vista in the years ahead. In my experience, Jason is thoughtful, principled, and guided by a strong sense of responsibility. His experience building multiple successful companies also gives him a practical understanding of leadership and problem solving.
AW
Business Leaders
### Aaron Bernard Watkins
SVP – Omnichannel Growth
Executive Colleague & Civic Partner
“Jason is not a politician. And that’s why he’s the perfect choice.”
Jason is not a politician. And that's why he's the perfect choice. I've known and worked with Jason for almost two decades and he's been the same — see a problem...solve that problem. No “it's not my job”, no “that's beneath me”, no “not my problem”. He just rolls up his sleeves and gets it done. That's why I wasn't surprised to hear that he threw his hat in the ring here. He cares deeply for education and if he notices a problem — rest assured he'll be on the front lines to solve it.
Community & Business Leaders
### Jones Chan
Founder / CEO, Thess Bar
Nonprofit & Community Board Colleague
“He has a gift for turning complicated issues into clear, practical, results-driven actions.”
I’ve had the privilege of serving with Jason Lin on the Thess Bar board and getting to know him and his family personally. Jason is thoughtful, highly intellectual, and a strong critical thinker, but what I appreciate most is his sincere heart for his family and his genuine concern for the welfare and future of his children. He has a gift for taking complicated and sometimes ambiguous issues, sorting through them carefully, and turning them into clear, practical, results-driven actions. I believe those qualities will serve the students and families well on the FUHSD Board.
RP
FUHSD Student
### Rohan Prabhakar
Student, FUHSD
FUHSD Student Voice
“I care about strong teachers, challenging classes, and preparing for life after high school.”
As an FUHSD student, I care about having strong teachers, challenging classes, and opportunities that actually prepare students for life after high school. Jason Lin has talked about protecting academic programs, supporting teachers, expanding career and internship opportunities, and helping students learn how to use AI responsibly. Those are issues that directly affect students like me, and I appreciate that he is focusing on them in his campaign for the FUHSD Board.
PH
FUHSD Teacher
### Pamela Hershey
Teacher for FUHSD
Fremont Union High School District Educator
“Jason understands the needs of the students to prepare them for the future.”
Jason understands the needs of the students to prepare them for the future. His excellent leadership skills will build consensus by collaboration with his fellow Trustees to solve issues while placing the focus on what is best for the students.
DL
Community & Parent
### Daniel Lin
Community Member and Parent
Cupertino & Sunnyvale Area Parent
“Jason cares passionately for his community and brings his experience in the business world to our schools.”
Jason cares passionately for his community and brings his experience in the business world and applying it in the schools. As an outsider, he doesn't need to cater to the establishment and can bring your voice back to the schools.
SL
Education & Mentoring
### Sabrina Lin
Director, Nexus Mentoring
Youth Mentorship & Education Advocate
“Jason has the life experience and skills to transform Fremont Union High School District.”
In this 21st-century, we need a leader who is visionary and optimistic about the future for our children. Jason has the life experience and skills to transform Fremont Union High school District. He is the type of leader we need now with all the AI and technological changes coming.
SJ
FUHSD Student
### Siddhant Jain
FUHSD Student
FUHSD Student Voice
“Jason understands that students need challenging academics, strong teachers, and real-world opportunities.”
As an FUHSD student, I’m proud to endorse Jason Lin for the FUHSD Board. I appreciate his focus on keeping our schools academically strong while preparing students for a future shaped by AI and a changing workforce. Jason understands that students need challenging academics, strong teachers, and more real-world opportunities like internships and career programs. I believe he will listen to student voices and make decisions that put our education and future first.
RZ
Cupertino High Student
### Robin Zhou
Student in Cupertino High School
Cupertino High School Student Voice
“He's focused on protecting schools, smart AI policies, and he listens before he acts.”
I'm endorsing Jason Lin for FUHSD School Board because he consistently puts students first. He's focused on against closing schools, AI policies, and he listens before he acts. Our schools need someone who is prepared, honest, and committed to every student's success.
KC
MVHS Teacher
### Katie Collins
MVHS Math Teacher
Monta Vista High School Educator
“Our kids are our best asset and Jason understands this.”
Jason wants to bring community, collaboration, and communication to our schools. Parents, teachers, and students should all feel we are working for the same goal and that is our kids. Our kids are our best asset and Jason understands this.
JD
Parents & Families
### Jesse Dixon
Community Parent
FUHSD Area 3 Family
“Jason Lin checks every box. A proven leader. An exceptional father and family man.”
Jason Lin checks every box. A proven leader. An exceptional father and family man. Jason lifts up everyone around him. He is bright, forward thinking, and also humble. Electing Jason to the school board will be a huge win for the community.
